project_metadata.description: Futuristic, cinematic landing page for AeroMac Dynamics: show aerospace, AI, R&D, and tech leadership.
project_metadata.core_purpose: Landing page to position AeroMac Dynamics as a leader in next-gen aerospace and AI, capturing premium leads and talent.
project_metadata.target_audience: Investors, aerospace clients, engineering talent, tech press
key_features: Hero with particle/starfield background, animated text and CTAs
Animated counters, timelines, 3D/hover UI, energy waves, neural net background
Premium careers/contact glass forms with neon animated borders
Responsive layout, dark theme, simulated data

pages.purpose: Showcase AeroMac Dynamics as a premium, futuristic aerospace/AI innovator and generate interest/leads.
pages.description: Single scroll landing experience. All sections layered over dark, animated particle backgrounds. Each begins at full viewport width, vertical stacking, large top/bottom padding (pt-32 pb-32). Section transitions use Framer Motion for scroll fade+slide+scale, z-index staggered per section (hero z-40, others step-down). Key elements: full hero animation, glassmorphism cards, cyber grid, animated counters/timelines, floating forms, and vivid neon effects. Typography: Inter/Space Grotesk, bold headers (up to 96px). Animations on all major interactive/scroll elements.
pages.content_notes: Scroll-driven, sectioned storytelling. All data simulated inline (counters, stats, showcases). All UIs to use neon blue/cyan, glassmorphism, floating grid/particle backgrounds, and premium bold-futuristic typography. Sections: Hero, About, Tech, AI, Drone, R&D, Careers, Contact, each visually distinct but unified by theme, large whitespace, and animated, high-contrast layouts. Forms are simulated only. Max width 1640px, responsive from 380px+. No backend/API.

theme.design_dna: Futuristic Premium Tech: SpaceX/Apple/NASA. Black stark base, glassmorphism overlays, neon gradients, silver/white primary text, high-contrast, glowing blue-cyan accents, large pill buttons, animated backgrounds, floating 3D layers, bold Inter/Space Grotesk, tight tracking, animated borders, smooth animated storytelling.
theme.animation_style: Framer Motion, CSS transitions, ambient particle/glow
theme.interaction_style: Magnetic hover, animated focus, scroll-fade-in/scale, typing effect

components.description: Sticky top bar, dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-opacity-60), 96px height, high z-index (50), left-aligned neon-blue logo (svg), right-aligned nav links (white text, tracking-wider, uppercase, spaced x8), magnetic hover underline, transitions with Framer Motion. Elevation shadow 2xl. Covers all page sections (anchors).
components.purpose: Top-level persistent navigation, anchors to all landing page sections.

components.description: Full-width, dark glassmorphism bar, px-8 py-6, silver smallprint, compact logo left, social icons (Lucide), simple links (Contact, Careers), border-t-2 neon-cyan with animated gradient pulse. Layered above background, z-30.
components.purpose: Displays company legal, social, and secondary navigation.

components.description: Full viewport, flex-center, layered: Particle starfield bg (absolute, -z-10), animated aerospace environment video (absolute, -z-20, slight blur), foreground text col (centered), headline in white (font-bold, text-[96px], tight tracking, drop-shadow), animated typing subline (blue/cyan gradient text, Framer Motion blinking cursor), two pill-shaped CTA buttons (primary neon-cyan, secondary glass-white/outline, xl, glowing outer border, magnetic on hover). Bottom chevron animate to signal scroll.
components.purpose: First impression, branding, and navigation gateway.

components.description: 2-col layout (lg: grid-cols-2, gap-16), left: glassmorphism card (backdrop-blur-xl, px-10 py-12, shadow-xl, white/silver text, logo watermark w/ opacity), About summary (heading, body), right: glassmorphism stat cards (4x1 row, floating, neon border, hinge animation on scroll), each: icon, animated counter (projects, countries, engineers, patents), label (cyan text, sm font-bold).
components.purpose: Showcase AeroMac overview and metrics visually.

components.description: Cyber-grid dark background (animated lines, grid-glow), floating interactive technology cards (glassmorphism, hover 3D-tilt + neon-cyan border glow, slight shadow), each: image (white/silver, drop-shadow), title (font-bold), description (gradient-blue text). Holographic UI floating widgets (blurred, animated opacity on scroll).
components.purpose: Presents core aerospace tech visually and interactively.

components.description: Dark neural net animation (canvas/svg webgl) background behind glassmorphism cards (3 feature panels, left-right stagger animation), each: neon border, title (bold, white), cyan bullet points, subtle glow icon top-left, floating dots, Framer Motion fade-in. z-index 20.

Glass cards (backdrop-blur, neon inner-outer glow), flex row (md:4 cols), each: drone image (floating, transform:perspective 3D tilt on hover), title (cyber-font), animated specs ticker below, blue-light ambient effect. Accent: floating pulses around cards.
components.purpose: Showcase leading drone products and capabilities.

components.description: Full-width, black canvas, animated SVG energy waves as timeline base (cyan-blue pulse anim), horizontal steps (glassmorphism tiles, neon to white, scale-on-scroll), each: year (bold), milestone title (white), description (silver, small). Timeline dots: glowing, staggered on scroll.
components.purpose: Demonstrates R&D progression and history interactively.

components.description: Glassmorphism form (backdrop-blur, px-10 py-12, max-w-md), neon-cyan focus glowing inputs (rounded-lg, animated border), big bold headline, small description (white/silver), floating button (pill, neon animated border, glow), Framer Motion validate in/out. Input icons left, error underfield fade-in-out. Smooth-hover submit with state change.
components.purpose: User entry for job interest; recruitment showcase.

components.description: 2-col grid: Left, glass contact form (name, email, message), rounded-xl, neon-cyan border, backdrop-blur-lg, input icons, animated send button (gradient neon pulse, disabled on submit, spinner). Right, office info (cta), map bg (blurred, overlay), both fade-in with scroll.
components.purpose: For user to reach AeroMac; direct comms.

frontend.styling: Tailwind CSS v4, prefer utility classes
frontend.state_management: Inline React useState/useEffect, no global stores
frontend.animation: Framer Motion, CSS keyframes, particle/starfield JS
